actual_channel_cases.operation: Run exact first template once, then exact next template once per explicitly selected contiguous view
constraints: no loop or automatic cursor advancement

actual_channel_cases.operation: Nested truncation negative control, then intact same-cursor retry
actual_channel_cases.fault_injection: Reviewer-approved test-only reduction of nested output budget sufficient to cause an actual tool truncation; do not install that template or budget as candidate production guidance
actual_channel_cases.invariant: Exact reader/reference prefix and closed VIEW selector/start remain identical; retain the full actual envelope, output/truncation metadata and integer completion status
actual_channel_cases.required_result: Reject the truncated response without advancing; retry the same selector/start with exact normal template caps20000/16384 and VIEW cap4096/reserve2048, then validate intact original slice

actual_channel_cases.operation: Outer truncation negative control, then intact same-cursor retry
actual_channel_cases.fault_injection: Reviewer-approved test-only reduction of outer output budget sufficient to cause actual functions.exec truncation while retaining the actual nested result in own fixture collector state; do not install that template or budget as candidate production guidance
actual_channel_cases.invariant: Exactly one nested call and one forwarded actual result; reader/reference prefix and closed VIEW selector/start remain unchanged
actual_channel_cases.required_result: Reject the outer-truncated response without advancing; retry the same selector/start with exact normal template caps20000/16384 and VIEW cap4096/reserve2048, then validate intact original slice

fresh_author_case.gate: Root followup after review/freeze authorizes exactly one fresh unrelated smoke author
fresh_author_case.message: Exact generated candidate agent_message bound only to own unrelated carrier reference
fresh_author_case.expected_behavior: Full system-before-user contiguous inspection through both explicit EOF views; no hints, examples, previous task answers, helper/history/other-agent reads, retrieval deadline or resampling
fresh_author_case.structured_output: One literal syntactically valid JSON response naming all preregistered fixture-only markers and exact reconstructed field SHA256 roots, EOF and decoded character totals
fresh_author_case.syntax_control: Author may JSON.parse only its own exact draft in memory and fix syntax within the same request; controller retains and forwards literal FINAL without cleanup
fresh_author_case.required_retention: Every original response/draft that is actually exposed, literal FINAL, actual tool envelope, native message bytes/hash, unique author identity, source/input freeze, and failed result; no cleanup or retry author

required_actual_records: Full unmodified actual exec_command result envelopes and functions.exec result envelopes, including truncation observations
Exact source/prefix/VIEW/template bytes and SHA256 roots
Exact nested command argv interpretation: python -I -B -, isolated inline source stdin, no helper file
Integer completion status; no unresolved session result counts as a completed view
Raw stdout, stderr, forwarded output and literal FINAL bytes/hashes
Explicit before/after selector and cursor for every intact, truncated, rejected and same-cursor retry record
Independent gap/overlap/tail/Unicode/UTF8/cap/EOF reconstruction against unrelated original fixture only
authority_limits: Prepared protocol and pure controls are not actual-channel or fresh-agent qualification
Fault injection requires explicit root review because exact normal caps exceed the bounded view size and do not guarantee actual truncation
Finite fixture availability/progress success does not attest semantic consumption or grant ACCEPT, TESTED, END_TO_END_VERIFIED, proof or lifecycle authority
No production activation before new immutable whole source/input roots, fresh registered whole-root qualification, independent actual audit and fresh native task stage
No prior source-root PASS reuse, stage018 mutation, old task answers, task-specific hints or token reduction claim
